_comment: Shared expectations for the password policy, read by both the backend
implemented twice - once in UserManager.validate_password and once in
src/lib/password.js - and this table is what keeps the two agreeing on
the rules, their order and their exact messages.
Only use blocklist entries that are in BOTH copies of the list: the
browser carries a subset. The generated patterns always are.

cases.name: too short
cases.error: Password must be at least 12 characters long.

cases.name: empty
cases.error: Password must be at least 12 characters long.

cases.name: a common password, long enough to clear the length rule
cases.error: This password is among the most commonly used ones. Please choose a different one.

cases.name: a common password in mixed case
cases.error: This password is among the most commonly used ones. Please choose a different one.

cases.name: a generated repeat pattern
cases.error: This password is among the most commonly used ones. Please choose a different one.

cases.name: the product name doubled
cases.error: This password is among the most commonly used ones. Please choose a different one.

cases.name: shortness is reported before commonness
cases.error: Password must be at least 12 characters long.

cases.name: contains the email local part
cases.error: Password must not contain your email address.

cases.name: contains the email local part in another case
cases.error: Password must not contain your email address.

cases.name: contains the username
cases.error: Password must not contain your username.

cases.name: a three-character username is too short to match
a four-character username is just long enough to match
cases.error: Password must not contain your username.

cases.name: astral characters count as one character, not two
cases.error: Password must be at least 12 characters long.

cases.name: twelve astral characters satisfy the length rule
